description: This file contains a fake implementation of Kubernetes Event client methods for testing purposes, including create, update, patch, search, and get field selector functions.

methods.name: CreateWithEventNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new event in the specified namespace, deprecated in favor of context-aware version.

methods.name: CreateWithEventNamespaceWithContext
methods.description: Creates a new event with a specified context.

methods.name: UpdateWithEventNamespace
methods.description: Updates an existing event, deprecated in favor of context-aware version.

methods.name: UpdateWithEventNamespaceWithContext
methods.description: Updates an existing event with a specified context.

methods.name: PatchWithEventNamespace
methods.description: Patches an existing event, deprecated in favor of context-aware version.

methods.name: PatchWithEventNamespaceWithContext
methods.description: Patches an existing event with a specified context.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for events matching an object, deprecated in favor of context-aware version.

methods.name: SearchWithContext
methods.description: Searches for events matching an object with a specified context.

methods.name: GetFieldSelector
methods.description: Returns a field selector for filtering events related to a specific involved object.
